summary: Fail closed when pull_request_target event base SHA differs from current provider main at authenticated fetch time; never execute PR code in privileged step.

regression_evidence.before: old source lacks trusted-current-main fetch and guard
regression_evidence.after: local exact-source static assertion passed; exact-head GitHub Actions required after commit

limitations: Does not turn Free private into provider-enforced branch protection.
Does not prove separate native reviewer or production pull_request_target job.
A main change after fetch still requires independent exact-head validation.
